intro: Nigeria is one of Africa's biggest economies, built on oil, farming, trade and a booming creative industry.

chapters.title: Oil
text: Oil from the Niger Delta provides most export earnings, but spills have badly polluted the delta. The Dangote refinery, opened in 2024, is one of the largest in the world.

chapters.title: Beyond oil
text: Nigeria is a top producer of cassava, yams and cocoa. Lagos has a fast-growing tech scene, and Nollywood makes thousands of films a year.

cardGroups.title: Made in Nigeria
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Nigeria makes and sells to the world.
